name: fiware
label: FIWARE Smart Data Models
description: EU-backed open data models — smart cities, agrifood, energy, environment

table_notes.fw_weather_observed: Point-in-time meteorological readings from a physical or virtual weather station, following the FIWARE WeatherObserved data model.
table_notes.fw_air_quality_observed: Pollutant concentrations and computed AQI from an air quality monitoring station, following the FIWARE AirQualityObserved data model.
table_notes.fw_traffic_flow_observed: Vehicle count, occupancy and speed at a road sensor location, following the FIWARE TrafficFlowObserved data model.
table_notes.fw_waste_container: Physical waste bin or container with fill-level telemetry and service status, following the FIWARE WasteContainer data model.
table_notes.fw_device: IoT device registry entry tracking hardware state, owner, signal strength and last reported value, following the FIWARE Device data model.

fw_weather_observed.name: id
fw_weather_observed.description: Surrogate primary key for the observation record

fw_weather_observed.name: station_id
fw_weather_observed.description: External identifier of the weather station (e.g. WMO ID or operator code)

fw_weather_observed.name: name
fw_weather_observed.description: Human-readable name or label for the weather station

fw_weather_observed.name: location
fw_weather_observed.description: WGS84 geographic position of the station. Enables ST_DWithin proximity queries.

fw_weather_observed.name: observed_at
fw_weather_observed.description: UTC timestamp of when the meteorological values were measured

fw_weather_observed.name: temperature
fw_weather_observed.description: Ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius at time of observation

fw_weather_observed.name: feels_like_temperature
fw_weather_observed.description: Perceived temperature (heat index / wind chill) in degrees Celsius

fw_weather_observed.name: wind_speed
fw_weather_observed.description: Wind speed in metres per second

fw_weather_observed.name: wind_direction
fw_weather_observed.description: Wind direction in degrees clockwise from true north (0–360)

fw_weather_observed.name: precipitation
fw_weather_observed.description: Accumulated precipitation in millimetres over the observation period

fw_weather_observed.name: weather_type
fw_weather_observed.description: FIWARE-coded weather condition array, e.g. ["rain", "fog"]. Values follow FIWARE WeatherObserved weatherType vocabulary.

fw_air_quality_observed.name: id
fw_air_quality_observed.description: Surrogate primary key for the air quality observation record

fw_air_quality_observed.name: station_id
fw_air_quality_observed.description: External identifier of the air quality monitoring station

fw_air_quality_observed.name: location
fw_air_quality_observed.description: WGS84 geographic position of the monitoring station

fw_air_quality_observed.name: observed_at
fw_air_quality_observed.description: UTC timestamp of when the pollutant concentrations were measured

fw_air_quality_observed.name: co
fw_air_quality_observed.description: Carbon monoxide (CO) concentration in micrograms per cubic metre (μg/m³)

fw_air_quality_observed.name: pm10
fw_air_quality_observed.description: Particulate matter ≤10μm diameter concentration in μg/m³

fw_air_quality_observed.name: pm25
fw_air_quality_observed.description: Fine particulate matter ≤2.5μm diameter concentration in μg/m³

fw_air_quality_observed.name: aqi
fw_air_quality_observed.description: Computed Air Quality Index value (scale varies by country; typically 0–500 US AQI)

fw_traffic_flow_observed.name: id
fw_traffic_flow_observed.description: Surrogate primary key for the traffic flow observation record

fw_traffic_flow_observed.name: road_segment_id
fw_traffic_flow_observed.description: External identifier of the road segment or loop detector being observed

fw_traffic_flow_observed.name: location
fw_traffic_flow_observed.description: WGS84 geographic position of the traffic sensor

fw_traffic_flow_observed.name: observed_at
fw_traffic_flow_observed.description: UTC timestamp of the traffic flow measurement

fw_traffic_flow_observed.name: intensity
fw_traffic_flow_observed.description: Number of vehicles counted per hour at this sensor location

fw_traffic_flow_observed.name: occupancy
fw_traffic_flow_observed.description: Fraction of time the detector was occupied by vehicles (0.0–1.0)

fw_traffic_flow_observed.name: average_vehicle_speed
fw_traffic_flow_observed.description: Space-mean speed of vehicles passing the sensor in km/h

fw_waste_container.name: id
fw_waste_container.description: Surrogate primary key for the waste container record

fw_waste_container.name: name
fw_waste_container.description: Human-readable label or street address description for the container

fw_waste_container.name: location
fw_waste_container.description: WGS84 geographic position of the waste container

fw_waste_container.name: fill_level
fw_waste_container.description: Current fill fraction reported by sensor (0.0 = empty, 1.0 = full)

fw_waste_container.name: fill_level_updated_at
fw_waste_container.description: UTC timestamp when fill_level was last updated by sensor or manual report

fw_waste_container.name: capacity_liters
fw_waste_container.description: Total volumetric capacity of the container in litres

fw_waste_container.name: last_emptied_at
fw_waste_container.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent emptying service event

fw_device.name: id
fw_device.description: Surrogate primary key for the IoT device registry entry

fw_device.name: category
fw_device.description: Array of FIWARE device category tags, e.g. ["sensor", "meter", "actuator"]

fw_device.name: location
fw_device.description: WGS84 geographic position where the device is physically installed

fw_device.name: owner
fw_device.description: Name or identifier of the entity that owns and is responsible for this device

fw_device.name: battery_level
fw_device.description: Battery charge fraction (0.0 = depleted, 1.0 = full). NULL for mains-powered devices.

fw_device.name: rssi
fw_device.description: Received Signal Strength Indicator in dBm (negative; closer to 0 = stronger signal)

fw_device.name: date_last_value_reported
fw_device.description: UTC timestamp when this device last successfully transmitted a data value

short_description: EU-backed open data models — smart cities, agrifood, energy, environment
long_description: FIWARE Smart Data Models are the EU-backed reference schemas for smart city and IoT applications, maintained by TM Forum, IUDX, and the FIWARE Foundation. The schema covers weather observations, air quality measurements, traffic flow counts, waste container fill levels, and IoT device registry — the five most commonly deployed models.
when_to_use: Use for smart city platforms, environmental monitoring dashboards, or any IoT application targeting EU markets. Used by 300+ cities in the EU Smart Cities Marketplace. Required for compliance with many EU Horizon and CEF Digital grants. The Catania, Porto, Santander, and Helsinki smart city reference implementations all use FIWARE data models.
